pr.body:
Clicking a winpc session's lane on the Mac opened claude.ai in the browser. Sessions of this machine open in the Claude desktop app (`claude://code/continue?session=…`), but one elsewhere has only its Remote Control link, `https://claude.ai/code/session_…`, which macOS hands to the browser.

The Claude desktop app's URL handler takes `claude://claude.ai/code/session_…` and shows that session in the app (its `claude.ai` host, `code` route). Tried by hand on this Mac: `open "claude://claude.ai/code/session_01MRK3WpFSD1YjG78pT31JKN"` focused that winpc session in the app (`LocalSessions.setFocusedSession` in the app's log).

Changes:
- `src/core/desktop.ts`: `inAppUrl(url)` turns an https claude.ai code session link into the `claude://` form, and returns undefined for anything else (another host, another path, http).
- `apps/desktop/src/main.ts` `pw:goto`: opens the in-app form when the session is not this machine's and `app.getApplicationNameForProtocol("claude://")` names an app; the web link otherwise.
- `src/bin/cli.ts` `goto`: on macOS opens the in-app form and falls back to the web link when `open` fails. `--print` still prints the web link; Windows and Linux are unchanged.
- The phone app keeps the web link.

Tests: `inAppUrl` cases. The full suite passes.
